description:
Welcome to FixItWithFil! Get real-world DIY home repairs, electrical projects, tool reviews, and automotive maintenance from a licensed electrician.

Whether you need to wire a 3-way switch, replace an outlet, troubleshoot a GFCI, or handle a weekend project, I share honest advice, practical skills, and real projects. No clickbait. No shortcuts.

🔔 Subscribe to learn new skills, save money, and join the next project!

📩 Contact: officialfixitwithfil@gmail.com

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: Videos are for informational/educational purposes. Electrical work is dangerous. Always follow local codes, turn off/verify power, and use safety precautions. Only perform work you are legally permitted and comfortable doing. If unsure, contact a licensed electrician. Fix It With Fil is not responsible for injury, damage, or loss.
